targets.label: Appendices B-D universal linear-independence and separability claim

feature_match.reason: Independent tests support the corrected finite-set theorem and reproduce stable counterexamples to the unqualified printed statement.

numeric_closeness.reason: Explicit Fock and analytic Gram matrices agree within 9.77e-12; all 64 labels interpolate within 9.33e-15.

paper_scope_coverage.reason: The single-mode, multi-mode, arbitrary-label and domain-qualification branches of the printed claim are all adjudicated.

evaluation.pixel_status_reason: This is an analytic claim; rank, residual and counterexample artifacts replace an inapplicable pixel comparison.

direct_cause.statement: The printed universal statement fails without identifying phases modulo 2*pi, and Proposition 1 is false as written even though the corrected finite-set feature-space conclusion is supported.

root_cause.statement: The paper omits the physical phase-domain qualification, states an insufficient affine-separability condition, and uses nonzero pairwise overlaps as an invalid proof of multi-mode linear independence.

code_fault_assessment.statement: Exact counterexamples, independent Fock and analytic-Gram paths, convergence checks and isolated execution agree; no reproduction-code fault was found.

checks.statement: Every phase, cutoff, tolerance and counterexample coordinate is frozen in the T005 config and traced as a paper value or independent falsification choice.
Focused tests cover phase periodicity, Vandermonde rank, Gram parity, affine interpolation and the Proposition 1 counterexample.
Inputs phi and phi+2*pi generate the same state to 1.32e-15, and the three-point affine counterexample fails by an exact rank condition.
The explicit tensor-product Fock Gram converges to the independently evaluated closed-form overlap Gram with 9.77e-12 maximum error.
The theorem probe ran from five declared inputs with no forbidden raw, reference or original-figure access.

alternative_hypotheses.statement: A shared rank or truncation bug would not survive both the exact affine counterexample and the independent analytic-Gram crosscheck.
The corrected finite-set result was checked by two independent representations and all 64 binary labelings on the declared six-point test set.

affected_scope.summary: Only the wording and proof of the universal Appendix B-D claim are disputed; the finite feature-map result survives under an explicit modulo-2*pi domain condition.
affected_scope.completion: Implementation and falsification are complete; final paper-error classification waits for fresh-context review.

next_discriminating_test.action: A fresh-context reviewer must independently rederive the phase-domain and affine-rank conditions and attempt to falsify both counterexamples without reading the original reproduction discussion.
next_discriminating_test.expected_resolution: Agreement promotes the result to a paper-error candidate; disagreement reopens the mathematical or implementation diagnosis.
